LEARN VOID

Writing to the console

Write one line to standard output and return a separate application status.

Write one record

use console provides borrowed standard endpoints. Running this main writes a line to stdout. A successful write returns status zero from the application.

Check output errors

A redirected stream may be closed. Check the result of console.stdout.write. An I/O error can include partial progress. The example returns a failure status if the write fails.

Ask about terminal capabilities

Query an endpoint’s capabilities() before relying on colors, cursor movement or keyboard input. Capabilities can differ between stdout and stderr. Use flush() when a prompt must appear before a read.
